title: taxonomy.json - the fixed lists of categories and tags
description: The single place where the categories and the tags are listed (owner plans of 2026-10-10). Decisions, questions and risks use 'decision_categories' (the same six topics); log entries use 'log_categories'; research items use 'research_categories' (their kind). Every one of them has exactly two tags from 'tags'. tools/portal-sync-check.ps1 reports BAD-LABEL otherwise. Adding a tag means editing this file and noting it in the log.
